title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman regrets misunderstanding Ilamathi and opens up to his friend. Meanwhile, Ganthimathi is moved upon learning that Ilamathi borrowed money for her surgery.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Shanmugam quits his job after learning the truth, refusing to work for Karna. Later, Karna receives a court notice to appear for an investigation in Parvathy's case.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar vows to protect his family's honour after uncovering Poongodi's plan. However, things backfire when Pandian abducts her from Selvi's home.

title: Sindhu Bairavi
description: Bairavi finds her photos at Sanjay's house, discovering his secret love. She confronts him for creating a rift with Arumugam, realising Arumugam was right.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Bhagyaraj brings Revathi home after Thangaraj's mistreatment. Despite Thangaraj begging Raghavan for forgiveness, Bhagyaraj strictly refuses to send Revathi back.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Senthil gets suspended from his job after being exposed for taking a bribe. Later, Pandian lashes out at Senthil for his actions and the resulting consequences.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: After receiving assurance from Aneesh, Cheran leaves Chandayatha with her parents. Later, his brother's playful teasing about her pregnancy leaves Cheran puzzled.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rekha's father convinces Sathya to manage his business while secretly plotting to keep them at home permanently. Pressured by Devika, Manoj registers his marriage to Kanaga.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Sethupathi worries as Aishwarya is rushed to the hospital in critical condition after a scorpion bite. Meanwhile, Malar informs Tamizhselvi, who wishes to visit Aishwarya.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu confronts her father, questioning him about the attack on Arjun. Maran frightens and embarrasses Kasthuri by deliberately throwing a lizard at her.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: The groom refuses to marry Indhira after learning about her conditions. Meanwhile, Murugan is delighted when Indhira wishes for him to find his ideal life partner.
